# Rayvern Chng — Financial Advisor in Singapore

## Overview
Rayvern Chng is a certified financial advisor based in Singapore, specialising in business insurance, corporate financial planning, estate planning, and special needs advisory. He serves business owners, managing directors, HR heads, and corporate leaders across Singapore.

## Credentials
- AWP (CFP) — Associate Wealth Planner / Certified Financial Planner
- IBFQ Level 1 — Insurance Business Faculty Qualification
- AEPP — Advanced Estate Planning Practitioner
- MDRT — Million Dollar Round Table qualifier

## Services

### Business & Corporate Insurance
Key person insurance, group insurance and employee benefits, business continuity planning, buy-sell agreement funding. Designed for SMEs and corporate clients in Singapore who need to protect against the financial impact of losing critical personnel.

### Financial Advisory & Wealth Planning
Wealth accumulation strategies, retirement planning (including CPF optimisation), investment strategy and portfolio review, risk management and protection planning. Tailored to business owners and high-net-worth individuals.

### Estate Planning & Succession
Will writing and review, trust structures (living trusts, testamentary trusts, insurance trusts), business succession planning, Lasting Power of Attorney (LPA). Coordinated approach integrating business and personal estate planning under Singapore law.

### Special Needs Advisory
SNTC (Special Needs Trust Company) trust planning, CPF Special Needs Savings Scheme (SNSS) nominations, insurance and care funding structured through trusts, Letter of Intent and care plan documentation. For families with special needs dependants in Singapore.

## Contact
Website: https://www.rayvernchng.com/
Service area: Singapore

## Regulatory Note
Rayvern Chng is a representative licensed under the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) regulatory framework. This information is for general reference and does not constitute financial advice.
